parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate how the potential difference across a resistance wire varies with the length of the wire. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • Switch on. • Place the sliding contact C on the resistance wire at a distance l = 10.0 cm from B. • Measure, and record in Table 2.1, the potential difference V across the length l of the resistance wire. • Measure, and record in Table 2.1, the current I in the circuit. • Repeat the procedure using l = 30.0 cm, 50.0 cm, 70.0 cm and 90.0 cm. • Switch off.
